description: Figure 7 compares the retrieval performance of different query selection strategies for the CAPSTONE model on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis represents the number of queries used for document expansion, denoted as $S$, with values ranging from 1 to 10 in increments of 1. The y-axis shows the MRR@10 score, which ranges from approximately 34 to 38. The plot displays two sets of lines: solid lines represent the performance of DPR retrievers with corpus expansion, and dotted lines represent the performance with the typical representation. For each strategy, the solid and dotted lines with the same color correspond to the same DPR model. The results show that the proposed curriculum sampling strategy (solid red line) performs best, with MRR@10 increasing from 34.26 at $S=1$ to 35.66 at $S=10$. In contrast, the typical representation (dotted red line) achieves a lower but still improving performance, starting at 35.66 and ending at 35.64. Other strategies, such as the top-1 query (solid blue line), also show improved performance with increasing $S$, but consistently underperform the curriculum sampling strategy.
